query:
SELECT 
  a.id, 
  a.devedorId, 
  a.status, 
  a.installments,
  a.agreedAmount / 100 as agreedAmount_reais,
  COUNT(p.id) as total_parcelas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'pendente' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as parcelas_pendentes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'pendente' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) / 100 as valor_restante_reais
FROM acordos a
LEFT JOIN parcelasAcordo p ON a.id = p.acordoId
WHERE a.devedorId = 120001 AND a.status = 'ativo'
GROUP BY a.id;
